'''Bugs (dangerous)''' are an [[Monsters|enemy]] found in [[the Mines]] after activating the [[The Mines#Shrine of Challenge|Shrine of Challenge]] or during the [[Quests#Danger In The Deep|Danger In The Deep]] quest. 80 cave insects (any type) need to be killed for the [[Adventurer's Guild#Monster Eradication Goals|Monster Eradication Goal]] at the [[Adventurer's Guild]].

==Behavior==
They initially behave similar to their weaker counterpart the [[Bug]]. They fly up and down or left and right in a fixed path. Once they get hit they will rotate and change their flight path, potentially hitting the player. 

==Strategy==
Hit them from the front as to not get hit once they rotate.

==History==
{{History|1.5|Introduced.}}
{{History|1.6|Changed Monster Eradication Goal for cave insects from 125 to 80.}}
